question: Which owners have the most open heat issues this month?
text: The owners with the most open heat issues reported this month are Isthmus Edge Properties (demo) with 8 issues and Prairie Rentals (synthetic) with 4 issues. Both owners are the only ones listed in the top results for open heat issues this month.
sql:
WITH ranked_owners AS (
  SELECT 
    o.name AS owner_name,
    COUNT(*) AS open_heat_issues,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank
  FROM `fixit`.`gold`.`reports` r
  JOIN `fixit`.`gold`.`properties` p ON r.property_id = p.property_id
  JOIN `fixit`.`gold`.`owners` o ON p.owner_id = o.owner_id
  WHERE r.status IN ('open','escalated')
    AND r.violation_category ILIKE '%HEAT%'
    AND r.reported_at >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, CURRENT_DATE)
    AND o.name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.name
)
SELECT owner_name, open_heat_issues
FROM ranked_owners
WHERE rank <= 10
ORDER BY open_heat_issues DESC;
